JUPITER achieved exascale status upon its 2024-2025 deployment at Forschungszentrum Jülich, Germany. The TOP500 rankings confirm operational exascale systems: Frontier (USA), Aurora (USA), and El Capitan (USA) precede JUPITER globally.

Statement 2's 2030 framing is anachronistic because exascale computing is *already achieved technology*. Scientists have developed these billion-billion-calculation systems—they're operational today. Framing JUPITER as "aiming for 2030" ignores this reality.
